UAT1 Expression Set (CML) — Conditions Reference

1903 rules, messages and defaults across 162 product types, translated to plain English. Use the filters below to narrow by product, section, rule action, or message severity.

Attributes — fields defined on the product. Rules — show/hide/disable UI elements. Messages — validation errors/warnings shown to the user. Defaults — auto-filled values (UoM, revenue type, quantity). Dependencies — cross-product requirements not otherwise enforced by a rule or message.

  • Monthly_Minimum1 (decimal(2))

    Options: None, 950M Events, 50M Events, 100M Events, 150M Events, 200M Events, 250M Events, 300M Events, 350M Events, 400M Events, 900M Events, 450M Events, 500M Events, 550M Events, 600M Events, 650M Events, 700M Events, 750M Events, 800M Events, 850M Events, 1B Events, 1.5B Events, 2B Events, 2.5B Events, 3B Events, 3.5B Events, 4B Events, 4.5B Events, 5B Events, > 5B Events

    Options: 10M LRUs, 5M LRUs, None, 25M LRUs, 50M LRUs, 75M LRUs, 100M LRUs, 250M LRUs, 500M LRUs, 750M LRUs, 1B LRUs, > 1B LRUs
  • qty (int)
    Default: this.quantity

NPIActivation extends LineItem

Attributes
  • Monthly_Minimum1 (decimal(2))
    Default: 0.00
  • Rev_Share1 (decimal(2))
    Default: 0.00
  • RevenueType (string)
    Options: Fixed, One-Time, Variable, None
  • Minimum_Commit_True_Up_Frequency (string)
    Options: None, Monthly, Quarterly, Annual
    Default: None
  • Business_Associate_Agreement_BAA (string)
  • UnitOfMeasure (string)
    Options: Impressions, Records Under Management, Revenue Share, LiveRamp Units, Tokens, None, CPM
  • LiveRamp_Units_V2 (string)
    Options: 10M LRUs, 5M LRUs, None, 500k LRUs, 1M LRUs, >10M LRUs
  • Impressions (string)
    Options: None, 500k Impressions, 1M Impressions, 2M Impressions, >2M Impressions
  • RUMTier (string)
    Options: None, 100k RUM, 500k RUM, 1M RUM, 200k RUM, 750k RUM, >1M RUM, >200M RUM
  • qty (int)
    Default: this.quantity

  • hide UnitOfMeasure value 'Tokens'
    When: always
    View CML
    rule(true, "hide", "attribute", "UnitOfMeasure", "value", "Tokens");
  • hide UnitOfMeasure value 'CPM'
    When: always
